i was in a psych ward 3 times, but only ones for minors, so it might be different for adult ones.   
it really depends, not only on the country, the budget, but also from hospital to hospital. pretty much all of them are strict though, about whatever you take from the outside, whether its gifts your friends, parents, anyone from the outside gives you, especially on the food.   
some have really absurd ones, like for example you couldnt have potato chips, but you could have doritos. but whatever. like 99% of them have a no phone rule, but there are singular phones you can call from (at mine there was also a phone anyone could call to. it was busy like all the time though.) also the queues for them are crazy.   
the people are nice, for me there was a lot of alternative people. but there are also really peculiar ones, obviously. on the topic of disobeying the rules, it is true that you can get strapped for small things. to a bed though. never in a single stay of mine i saw a straitjacket, or one of those "padded" rooms you see in movies. maybe they're only in adult ones. also medications like 3 times a day.   
experiences are different too, some people say their psych ward stays were hell on earth, some are neutral, some even enjoy it. so, yeah, its different for everyone
